diagnostics: Only failed rows get a second isolated reference-worker invocation for explanation. The score always comes from score_output. Diagnostics compare validated canonical tagged plain data, never candidate equality or repr. Each canonical value begins with its exact type tag; nested values retain their own tags.
interpretation: This is the official reference implementation pass rate under the final pilot verifier, not a mathematical ceiling on valid solutions. Alternative valid solutions can return the exact expected builtin types and values. No grader, extractor, task loader, controls or admission evidence is changed.
replay_command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 nice -n 10 taskset -c 6 pilot/.venv/bin/python -m pilot.reference_audit --out evidence/pilot/reference-audit-6

task_manifest.adaptation: Reference AST function declarations only; no bodies, examples or test assertions. Bounded Python agent-program adaptation, not official optimizer artifact.

solution_evaluator.answer_extraction: First exactly python-tagged or bare triple-backtick block, with surrounding horizontal whitespace allowed; unclosed eligible block consumes the remainder; whole output if none. Applied once at shared scoring boundary.
solution_evaluator.decision: The trusted parent alone validates the frame and compares exact canonical builtin types and values, or class name plus exact fields for structural records, after any official int wrapper. A zero exit and one well-formed frame are necessary, never sufficient; failures, extra output and unsupported values score zero.
solution_evaluator.trusted_plan: A separate bounded pinned-image invocation per row receives only the official reference, setup and assertions. Each assertion must be one equality whose left side is a positional call to an official reference function, optionally inside the official int wrapper. Arguments and the expected right side are evaluated there and returned as tagged plain data, cached by row contents only.
solution_evaluator.worker: A fresh network-disabled, read-only, non-root container per candidate row, without host mounts or host environment, receives only extracted source, target function names and tagged arguments. Custom argument objects are rebuilt from class name and fields without constructors, using the candidate class when defined. Calls run in official assertion order and return one bounded tagged-JSON frame.
